## Fixed `composition.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: aws-web-service
  labels:
    crossplane.io/xrd: xawswebservices.app.example.com
spec:
  group: app.example.com
  mode: Pipeline
  resources:
    - name: rds-instance
      base:
        apiVersion: database.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
        kind: Instance
        spec:
          forProvider:
            region: us-east-1
            engine: postgres
            engineVersion: "16.1"
            allocatedStorage: 20
          providerConfigRef:
            name: default
      patches:
        # FIX 1: corrected fromFieldPath to match the XRD parameter name
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.instanceClass
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
          transforms:
            - type: String
              string:
                type: Format
                format: "db.t3.%s"
      # FIX 2: added ReadinessChecks so the Composition can reach Ready
      readiness:
        - type: ResourceExists
        - type: MatchString
          matchString:
            fieldPath: status.conditions[?type=='Ready'].status
            values: ["True"]
```

### What changed and why

| # | Defect | Before | After | Rationale |
|---|--------|--------|-------|-----------|
| 1 | Wrong `fromFieldPath` | `spec.parameters.storageClass` | `spec.parameters.instanceClass` | The XRD (`xrd.yaml`) declares the composite parameter as `instanceClass`. The old path referenced a field that doesn't exist, so the patch silently failed to apply and the RDS instance was never sized. |
| 2 | Missing `ReadinessChecks` | `readiness: {}` | `ResourceExists` + `MatchString` on `Ready` condition | In **Pipeline** mode, a Composition is marked `Ready` only when every resource's readiness checks pass. An empty `{}` means "no checks configured," which Crossplane interprets as "never ready." Adding explicit checks tells Crossplane: *"this resource is ready when the managed RDS Instance has a `Ready: True` status condition."* |

### How the two fixes interact

```
CompositeClaim (AWSWebService)
        │
        ▼
   Composition (Pipeline)
        │
        ├── Patch: spec.parameters.instanceClass  ──►  spec.forProvider.instanceClass
        │         (FIX 1: now resolves correctly)
        │
        └── Readiness: ResourceExists + Ready==True  (FIX 2: now evaluable)
                    │
                    ▼
              status.conditions[Ready] = True
                    │
                    ▼
        Composition status.conditions[Ready] = True   ← "Ready"
```

Without Fix 1 the instance class would never be set (resource may fail to reconcile or come up with a default). Without Fix 2, even a perfectly reconciled RDS instance would leave the Composition stuck in `Pending`/`Creating` forever because Crossplane has no signal to flip the readiness condition to `True`.
